name: WOKING 720 GT3

real.trim: GT3 race car (a customer team's colours)

specs.notes: McLaren's 720S GT3 (2019 on, here in a customer team's colours): a race-prepared M840T 4.0 twin-turbo V8 behind the driver, a six-speed sequential in place of the road car's seven-speed dual clutch, a Salisbury limited-slip differential (McLaren, evo); the road 720S's 2,670 mm wheelbase. McLaren publishes no GT3 output (balance of performance sets it); ~600 bhp and 1,345 kg are quoted for the later LMGT3 Evo. Run to the APEX GT CHALLENGE's balance of performance (laps CINDER RIDGE within a few tenths of the AFFALTER GT3 on the AI's line: tests/race_ai_check.gd); its torque curve, aero and ratios are estimates.

garage.blurb: A carbon-tubbed GT3 with a twin-turbo V8 behind you and a canopy of glass above: it changes direction like a much smaller car and leaves the hairpins on a wave of boost.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit (cage, carbon tub, seat, the wheel with its screen): its wheel cut out by part inside a box (tools/cars/m720_gt3.json), the eye set by hand; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.
